_comment: Nullcast telemetry (PostHog). project_key is a PUBLIC PostHog project/ingest key — safe to commit; it is not a secret. Leave project_key empty (or set enabled=false) to turn telemetry off. host blank = US cloud (us.i.posthog.com); use https://eu.i.posthog.com for the EU cloud. This file is copied next to the .exe on build — edit it there and relaunch to change the key with no rebuild.
